name: Your laptop
summary: The agent runs on the machine you work on, as a CLI, desktop app or local daemon. It has direct access to your files and tools and costs nothing extra to host, but it only runs while the laptop is awake and online.
how: Install the agent as a CLI, app or background service
Point it at local files, tools and API keys
Run it on demand or while the machine is on
Optionally expose it to chat apps through a tunnel
facts: Coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex CLI; OpenClaw and Hermes Agent can also run locally
Full local access and privacy, but no uptime when the lid is closed
goodFor: Keeping data on your own machine
watchOut: Schedules and webhooks stop when the machine sleeps
Agent has broad access to your files; sandbox risky tools
